Step 1 — side walls. Looking straight down on the finished solid, its outline (the V with a flat at the bottom and a flat notch on the inside) has 8 straight edges: top of left arm, outer left side, outer bottom, outer right side, top of right arm, inner right side, inner flat, inner left side.

The strip must run once around these 8 faces. Its two ends meet at one corner, so the strip needs a crease at each of the other 8 − 1 = 7 corners.

Step 2 — top and bottom. Each V-shaped piece is folded over once along the edge where it joins the strip: 2 folds.

Total = 7 + 2 = 9 folds — option (A).
